sentences.en: I grew tomatoes last year and they were very good.
sentences.zh: 去年我种了西红柿，味道很好。

sentences.en: "Let me see .... Do you have tomato juice?" says Hiroshi.
sentences.zh: 让我看看……你有番茄汁吗？

sentences.en: I found some interesting heirloom tomatoes at the farmer's market.
sentences.zh: 我在农贸市场发现了一些有趣的西红柿品种。

senses.zh: 番茄，西红柿；番茄红，鲜红色；番茄植株；番茄，西红柿
